title: VAT calculator UI reorg: move Service/Product Category to Invoice, compact controls, improve VAT Category selector

requirements.summary: Move Service/Product Category input from the VAT calculator Transaction/Results UI into the Invoice step and render it as an invoice line-item column before Description.
acceptanceCriteria: In the VAT calculation flow, the user can no longer select or view “Service/Product Category” in the Results UI.
In the Invoice step (Invoice details), “Service/Product Category” is available as an input and appears before the item description input/column.
Existing invoice generation/preview still works and includes the selected category in the invoice line-item layout (as a column before Description, when a columnar line-item table is used).

file_operations.description: Remove the Service/Product Category selector from the transaction/results flow UI (currently in Transaction Details), while keeping the existing formData field intact for later use in the Invoice step.
Remove the Service/Product Category selector from this legacy/alternate transaction step UI so the category is not selectable/viewable in the transaction/results portion of the flow.

Add a Service/Product Category selector to the Invoice step UI, positioned before the Item Description field; bind it to the shared VATCalculationInput/formData field so the selection is preserved into preview.

Update invoice HTML line-item table to include a Category column before Description, and render the selected Service/Product Category value for the line item; ensure existing invoice rendering remains valid.

requirements.summary: Compact the Enable Reverse Charge and VAT Treatment controls to reduce card/box visual size without hurting readability.
acceptanceCriteria: The “Enable Reverse Charge” control is rendered with reduced padding/height compared to the current card layout while remaining readable and clickable.
The “VAT Treatment” control group is rendered more compactly (reduced padding/spacing), without truncating labels or rate badges.
No overlap/clipping occurs in common viewports (mobile + md/lg breakpoints).

file_operations.description: Adjust the Reverse Charge card and VAT Treatment card layout classes to be more compact (reduced vertical padding/margins, tighter gaps, smaller but readable typography) while maintaining accessible tap/click targets across breakpoints.

requirements.summary: Move VAT Category selector into the right column of the Transaction Details layout on md+ while keeping a sensible stacked order on mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: On md+ breakpoints, the “VAT Category” selector appears in the right column of the Transaction Details inputs area.
On mobile, the Transaction Details inputs remain in a single-column stacked layout with a logical field order.
No validation or calculation behavior changes as a result of the layout move.

file_operations.description: Refactor the Transaction Details section to a responsive grid (single-column on mobile; two columns on md+), placing VAT Category in the right column on md+ and ensuring field order remains logical when stacked on mobile.

requirements.summary: Limit the VAT Category dropdown to ~5 visible options at once with vertical scrolling for additional options, preserving keyboard navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: When opening the VAT Category dropdown, the options list shows a maximum of ~5 items without scrolling.
If more than 5 categories exist, the dropdown list is scrollable and all categories remain selectable.
Keyboard navigation still works within the scrollable dropdown (up/down + enter).

file_operations.description: Update the VAT Category SelectContent styling to enforce a fixed max height corresponding to ~5 items and enable overflow-y scrolling; keep the existing shadcn Select component composition (do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui).
